findings.title: MD5 Password Hashing - FIPS Violation
findings.detail: DVWA stores passwords as unsalted MD5 (e.g. admin:5f4dcc3b5aa765d61d8327deb882cf99). FIPS 140-2 prohibits MD5 for credential hashing.
findings.remediation: Replace with bcrypt cost=12 or Argon2id. Est: 4h

findings.title: SQL Injection - Login Bypass (Classic)
findings.detail: Login form: username=admin'-- password=anything bypasses auth. Entire user table dumpable via UNION SELECT in <60s.
findings.remediation: Parameterized queries + input validation + WAF. Est: 8h

findings.title: Blind SQL Injection - Data Exfiltration
findings.detail: User ID field vulnerable to time-based blind SQLi. Full schema and data exfiltration via boolean inference. Confirmed via sqlmap.
findings.remediation: Parameterized queries across all DB calls. Est: 8h

findings.title: Command Injection - OS-Level RCE
findings.detail: DVWA ping utility passes user input directly to shell_exec(). Payload: 127.0.0.1; id && cat /etc/passwd achieves full RCE as www-data.

findings.title: Unrestricted File Upload - PHP Webshell RCE
findings.detail: File upload accepts .php with no MIME or extension validation. Uploaded webshell (shell.php) confirmed executable at /hackable/uploads/shell.php.
findings.remediation: Server-side file type allowlist + rename + disable exec in upload dir. Est: 6h

findings.title: Hardcoded Database Credentials
findings.detail: config/config.inc.php contains plaintext: db_password=dvwa_demo_2026. Exposed to anyone with LFI or source access. Violates IA-5.
findings.remediation: Move secrets to env vars + Vault. Rotate immediately. Est: 3h

findings.title: CSRF - State-Changing Action Without Token
findings.detail: DVWA password change endpoint (/vulnerabilities/csrf) accepts GET with no CSRF token. Attacker page silently changes admin password on victim click.
findings.remediation: SameSite=Strict cookie + CSRF token on all state-changing requests. Est: 4h

findings.title: Stored XSS - Persistent Script Injection
findings.detail: Guestbook field stores raw HTML/JS. Cookie-stealing payload executes on every visitor load.

findings.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference - User Data Exposure
findings.detail: User profile URL /vulnerabilities/idor/?id=1 enumerates all user profiles by incrementing ID with no authorization check.
findings.remediation: Server-side authorization check on every object access. Est: 2h

findings.title: Missing HSTS / Insecure Transport
findings.detail: Strict-Transport-Security header absent. Application served over HTTP. SSL stripping via sslstrip trivially downgrades connections.
findings.remediation: Enable HTTPS + HSTS max-age=31536000 includeSubDomains. Est: 1h

findings.title: Missing CSP + Reflected XSS
findings.detail: No Content-Security-Policy header. Reflected XSS confirmed on search endpoint - arbitrary JS executes in victim browser.
findings.remediation: strict-dynamic CSP + output encoding + DOMPurify. Est: 3h

findings.title: PHP Version Disclosure + Default Error Pages
findings.detail: X-Powered-By: PHP/7.4.3 header exposes version. Default Apache error pages reveal server path. Enables targeted CVE exploitation.
findings.remediation: Suppress headers in php.ini + custom error pages. Est: 1h
